hassio_account.title: Connect your YI Home account
hassio_account.description: Enter your YI Home account. The password is sent directly to the YI RTSP App and is not stored in the Home Assistant config entry.

reconfigure.title: Update YI Home credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the current YI Home account and password. They are validated and stored by the YI RTSP App; the password is not stored in the Home Assistant config entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your YI Home account
reauth_confirm.description: YI rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current account and password. The password is sent directly to the YI RTSP App and is not stored in the Home Assistant config entry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the YI RTSP App.
error.rate_limited: YI temporarily rate-limited login attempts. Try again later.
error.account_setup_failed: The YI account could not be configured.

abort.app_required: Install and start the YI RTSP App first.
abort.invalid_discovery: The YI RTSP App published invalid discovery information.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered YI RTSP App.
abort.unsafe_backend: The YI RTSP App returned an unsafe backend state.
abort.app_auth_failed: Home Assistant could not authenticate to the YI RTSP App.
abort.already_configured: YI Camera Connect is already configured.
